title: Geometric component of polynomial formal fibre
statement: intermediate theorem used to prove formalFiber_isGeometricallyRegular

proof.text: Base change by a finite purely inseparable extension, decompose by completion-finite-extension, prove each factor regular using formal smoothness and derivations, and conclude from regularity of finite products.

lean.statement: theorem formalFiber_isGeometricallyRegular_component (A : Type u) [CommRing A] [IsDomain A] [IsNoetherianRing A] [IsLocalRing A] [IsAdicComplete (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) A] (p : ℕ) (hp : p.Prime) [CharP (Localization.AtPrime (⊥ : Ideal A)) p] (q : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [q.IsMaximal] (hq : q.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal A) (r : Ideal (Polynomial A)) [r.IsPrime] (hrq : r ≤ q) (hr : r ≠ ⊥) (hrA : r.comap (Polynomial.C : A →+* Polynomial A) = ⊥) : let C := AdicCompletion (IsLocalRing.maximalIdeal (Localization.AtPrime q)) (Localization.AtPrime q) Algebra.IsGeometricallyRegular r.ResidueField (r.Fiber C)
